title: NDRRMA reports 752 dead, 8,730 rescued
body: NDRRMA's 1pm Sunday situation update says 752 bodies have been found in Nepal, Onlinekhabar reports. Its district count is Chitwan 259, Nawalparasi East 184, Nawalparasi West 100, Gorkha 58, Nuwakot 52, Dhading 50, Tanahun 36 and Rasuwa 13, which adds exactly to 752.
The same NDRRMA update says 2,502 people remain out of contact and 8,730 have been rescued. It does not publish a current agency or location breakdown for the rescue total, so none is inferred.

Onlinekhabar says these figures come from NDRRMA's 1pm bulletin. Out of contact does not mean dead. Families should use official police and local authority channels, not unverified social media posts.
